title: Elux Firerose 5000 Ice Pop 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ice Pop from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection combines the sweet and tart flavours of mixed berries with a refreshing icy finish. This e-liquid offers a delightful frozen fruit treat, perfect for those who enjoy a cool and fruity vape. The smooth inhale delivers the juicy taste of mixed berries, while the exhale brings a refreshing icy sensation, creating a balanced and enjoyable vaping experience. The interplay of mixed berries and ice makes this flavour a refreshing choice for all-day vaping. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
